UK Children Treated for Ketamine-Linked Bladder Condition

A specialist clinic in Liverpool, Alder Hey, is treating children as young as 13 for chronic bladder problems caused by sustained ketamine use. Some severe cases require dialysis. This is the first such clinic in the county.
